notes.title: 🧼 We’re live on Steam!
notes.notes:
[i]Don’t Drop the Soap[/i] is [b]officially out[/b] and ready to play!

Run, jump, and slip your way through prison in this chaotic 2D platformer.
[b]Achievements[/b], [b]Leaderboards[/b], and [b]total soap-fueled chaos[/b] included.

👉 [b]Play now:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652910/Dont_Drop_The_Soap/

Thanks for all the support — [i]stay slippery[/i]! 💙

notes.title: Small Update – Steam Integration Patch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Quick update from the soap squad:

We just rolled out a small but mighty patch with some cool Steam features added based on your feedback:

[h1]✅ What’s New:[/h1]
[b]- Steam Achievements[/b] are live! Can you unlock Bar of Justice or Soap to the Top?
[b]- Steam Cloud Save[/b] support is now active – continue your escape across any device.
[b]- Steam Leaderboards[/b] added! Compete for fastest runs and show who’s the slipperiest bar in prison.
- Minor bug fixes and visual polish.

Thanks for playing [i]Don’t Drop the Soap[/i]! If you’ve enjoyed the chaos, consider leaving a review—it helps more than you think 💙

Stay soapy,
— The Soap Team 🫧
